summary: Frontend-only redesign testing of Leakpoint. Verified transparent top navbar (brand, 7-item capsule, hamburger dropdown, Controls button), Command Map full-page map with floating glass drawer (open by default, toggle/close), drawer stats, command bar (Highest emissions, Show cement, Go to ledger), sector/state filters + reset, ranking segmented control (Total/Intensity), rank row selection, selected-factory card + View factory link, invalid factory-id notice, drawer footer (add data -> /intake, factory index -> /factories), unread bell badge, and mobile (430px) responsive hamburger + dropdown navigation to all 7 routes. Smoke-checked Intake run+confirm extraction, Factories search + card link, Intervention detail with adoption-slider + record-estimate, Credits, Ledger export button, Alerts generate-digest. All 55 checks passed.

issues: Recharts warns: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — a chart container is briefly rendered with zero size (likely in a hidden/collapsed panel or during route transitions). Cosmetic console noise only; no visual defect observed.

action_items: (Low) Investigate Recharts width/height(-1) console warnings — add minWidth/minHeight or aspect to ResponsiveContainer, or avoid rendering charts while parent has 0 dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: Shell.tsx casts DropdownMenuContent/Item to `any` to bypass type errors — consider fixing the underlying types instead of casting.
UIProvider panelOpen is app-wide but only meaningful on '/'; state persists across routes (fine for session-only demo, worth documenting).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign is stable. Nav testids: nav-command-map, nav-data-intake, nav-factories, nav-interventions, nav-credits, nav-ledger, nav-alerts, brand-home, topbar-alerts, toggle-map-panel, open-navigation, nav-dropdown, menu-nav-*. Command Map testids: map-panel, close-map-panel, stat-{factories,emissions,potential,sectors}, command-input, command-submit, quick-command-*, command-feedback, map-sector-filter, map-state-filter, map-reset-filters, rank-total, rank-intensity, rank-factory-<id>, selected-factory, selected-factory-name, selected-emissions, selected-hotspot, selected-factory-detail, invalid-map-selection, map-add-data, view-all-factories. Mobile viewport must genuinely be resized to ~430px (capsule hides via display:none at that width).
